item.title: Commuters facing delays after person struck by train in western suburbs
item.description: WESTMONT, Ill. — Commuters are facing some delays on Tuesday morning after a person was struck by a train in suburban Westmont. item.title: Judge rules Buffalo Wild Wings can keep calling boneless wings 'boneless'
item.description: A judge has ruled Buffalo Wild Wings is allowed to continue calling their boneless wings "boneless," even though they are "essentially chicken nuggets."
